description: This file defines a PHP class 'mbinfo' that retrieves and parses system sensor data such as temperature, fan speed, and voltage by executing the 'sysctl' program and processing its output.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class providing methods to gather hardware sensor information like temperature, fans, and voltage.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Retrieves temperature sensor data by executing 'sysctl' and parsing the output.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Retrieves fan speed data using 'sysctl' output parsing.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Retrieves voltage sensor data from 'sysctl' command output.
